_comment: Feeds a Nadhr threat-intelligence mirror may publish. Each entry records its terms
with evidence (owner rule 2026-11-27: explicit commercial use and redistribution).
Enterprises add their own feeds here (for example file: URLs on an internal share).

providers.name: cert-polska
providers.title: CERT Polska Warning List
providers.evidence: https://cert.pl/en/warning-list/ (checked 2026-11-27): 'may be used by any user for any purpose, including commercial purposes'. Attribution not required; must not imply endorsement by NASK-PIB / CERT Polska.

providers.name: durablenapkin-scam
providers.title: Scam Blocklist by DurableNapkin
providers.evidence: File header '# License: MIT (https://mit-license.org/)' (checked 2026-11-27); maintainer's own research, no third-party feeds (github.com/durablenapkin/scamblocklist).

providers.name: netapi-compromised
providers.title: NetAPI compromised domains (related-phishing detections)
providers.evidence: https://netapi.com/compromised-urls/ (checked 2026-11-27): 'Published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)', 'Use it in commercial products, services and appliances'. Requires an active link wherever the data is shown or shared. Provenance (checked 2026-11-27): CERT Polska's list plus NetAPI's own detection on registry zone data and its crawler; its own detection never adds a top-100,000 domain. Nadhr takes only 'related-phishing' (CERT Polska is taken directly; sinkholed domains are harmless and excluded to save memory).
providers.attribution: NetAPI compromised domains, CC BY 4.0, https://netapi.com/compromised-urls/
